payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute column pixel counts; 2D DP with state (i, color) minimizing repaints for first i columns ending with color, transitioning via valid segment lengths j ∈ [x,y].
payload.rationale: The DP uses a 2D array dp[2][m+1] where first dimension is color (0/1) and second is column index, making it a 2D state DP. It iterates over columns and valid lengths to compute min repaints.
